summary: The focused regressions introduced by test fixture leakage are fixed and pass in the candidate branch. The full 880-test run still fails the accepted planning benchmark limit (median 16.90495 seconds in Docker); the same benchmark independently fails on the host (median 11.195419 seconds, maximum 11.773348 seconds, limit 10 seconds). Two additional errors in the full run were artifacts of mounting a linked worktree whose .git pointer is inaccessible inside Docker; both affected tests pass in a clean full Git clone. T-900 cannot pass until the benchmark contract is met on the declared reference environment and the outstanding T-009 round-4 review conditions are resolved and re-evaluated.

findings.summary: The accepted 100-gate/5,000-file planning benchmark requires median <=10 seconds. It reproducibly exceeds that limit on both the local macOS host (11.195419 seconds) and Docker Desktop Linux (16.90495 seconds). No performance claim is supported for this candidate.

Global STATE_DIR leakage between unittest classes caused false failures in telemetry and profile tests. The fixtures now save and restore the previous module-global value; the focused affected sequence passes (50 tests).

findings.summary: The narrowed cache inputs in verification-profiles/showcase.json and mutation-sensitive tests for the coverage lock and harness_invocation_upper_bound == 0 remain outstanding per Harness review. T-900 must be rerun after those changes.
